# Customer Support Escalation Playbook

Critical tickets involving a complete service outage, suspected data loss, or a security concern
must be escalated to the on-call engineer immediately. The Support Manager should also be notified
when three or more customers report the same critical issue within 30 minutes.

High-priority tickets should receive an initial response within one business hour. Medium and low
priority tickets follow the standard four- and eight-business-hour response targets.

Support agents must not promise credits or refunds. They should document the customer impact and
request approval from the Support Manager; credits above $1,000 also require Finance approval.
Internal investigation notes must not be copied into customer-facing replies.
